fax.title: 1829 Printer's Manuscript
fax.info: Complete handwritten copy of the Printer’s Manuscript, copied by Oliver Cowdery and delivered to the printer.

fax.title: 1830 Palmyra Edition
fax.info: First Edition, printed by E.B. Grandin in Palmyra, New York, based on the Printer’s Manuscript.

fax.title: 1837 Kirtland Edition
fax.info: Second Edition, printed in Kirtland, Ohio, revised from the first edition using the Printer’s Manuscript.

fax.title: 1840 Nauvoo Edition
fax.info: Third Edition, printed in Nauvoo, revised by Joseph Smith comparing to the Original Manuscript.

fax.title: 1841 Liverpool Edition
fax.info: First European Edition, reprint of the Second American Edition (1837) with British spellings, printed in Liverpool.

fax.title: 1842 Nauvoo Edition
fax.info: Fourth American Edition, printed in Nauvoo with a low run of 640 copies, 1840 plates with a new title page.

fax.title: 1879 Salt Lake City Edition
fax.info: Deseret News Printing and Publishing Establishment, major LDS edition.

fax.title: 1920 Salt Lake City Edition
fax.info: Edited by James E. Talmage; added introductions, double columns, chapter summaries, new footnotes, and paragraphing.

fax.title: 1981 Salt Lake City Edition
fax.info: Official version edited by committee led by Bruce R. McConkie; includes corrections and restorations.

fax.title: 2013 Salt Lake City (Current) Edition
fax.info: Official current version based on the format and pagination of the 1981 edition; includes amendments.

fax.title: Poetic Parallelisms in the Book of Mormon
fax.info: Poetic Parallelisms in the Book of Mormon: The Complete Text Reformatted arranges the text in their poetic form including 325 instances of chiasmus and hundreds of additional parallel structures.
